summary: Most IO rows have strong line/equipment associations and correct IO/signal/system fields. However, several hardwired IOs lack required line or equipment tags and have insufficient geometry evidence, especially for SSV and PSAL types. These gaps should be addressed to ensure traceability and compliance.

comments.issue: Hardwired IO (DI) for PSAL-1762P-25 is missing a process line or equipment tag.
comments.reason: All hardwired IOs (except F&G area or hand switches) must be traceable to a process line or equipment for commissioning and maintenance.
comments.evidence_needed: PID drawing or geometry evidence showing the associated line or equipment.

comments.issue: Hardwired DO for SSV-1414P-02 lacks a connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only references a downstream valve, not a process line.
comments.reason: Shutdown valves must be associated with a process line or equipment for traceability and safety validation.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence linking SSV-1414P-02 to a specific process line or equipment.

comments.issue: Hardwired DO for SSV-1414P-07 lacks a connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only references a downstream valve.
comments.reason: Shutdown valves require a process line or equipment tag for proper loop documentation and validation.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence linking SSV-1414P-07 to a process line or equipment.

comments.issue: Hardwired DO for SSV-1762P-08 lacks a connected line or equipment tag; geometry evidence only references an upstream valve.
comments.reason: Shutdown valves must be traceable to a process line or equipment for safety and maintenance.
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence linking SSV-1762P-08 to a process line or equipment.

comments.issue: Hardwired AI for VENT-5000-IN is missing a process line tag; geometry evidence references only nearby equipment (M-26113-01) with moderate confidence.
comments.reason: Field devices should be associated with a process line or equipment unless clearly justified (e.g., direct-to-equipment measurement).
comments.evidence_needed: PID or geometry evidence confirming direct association to M-26113-01 or a process line.
